message.content: I run a small sailing club's website. I'd like members to be able to sign up for race-committee duty on it instead of the paper sheet at the clubhouse. Can we brainstorm it before anything gets built?

content.text:
The folder is empty, so I'm working from what you've told me.

What's going wrong with the paper sheet today that you want this to fix?

message.content: Slots go unfilled, and the duty officer ends up phoning people the night before a race.

content.text:
You want every slot filled without the phone calls.

Who should be able to see which slots are still open?

message.content: Any member. They all have a login on the site already.

content.text:
Here are two ways to build it.

1. A sign-up page on the site. It lists each race day's duty slots. A signed-in member takes an open slot with one click, and the page shows open slots to every member. It uses the logins you already have. I recommend this one.
2. A shared spreadsheet linked from the site. It is quicker to set up, but anyone with the link can change anyone's entry, and it can't remind people.

Which do you want?
